data.one_liner: Splash screen utility using Flare animations during app initialization.
data.what_it_does: It displays a splash screen with a Flare animation while your app performs startup tasks or waits for a loading state. Once initialization completes or the animation finishes, it automatically navigates to the next screen or triggers a callback.
use_when: You want a splash screen powered by a Flare animation.
You need to run asynchronous initialization tasks during app startup before showing the main screen.
avoid_when: You are using Rive instead of Flare (use rive_splash_screen instead).
You do not need animations for your app's splash screen.
strengths: Simplifies animated splash screen setup with flexible animation modes (intro, loop, end).
Supports both callback-based and declarative navigation builders.
weaknesses: Relies on the older Flare format which has been largely superseded by Rive.
Limited to splash screens and loading initialization flows.

alternatives.name: rive
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick rive if you are using modern Rive animations instead of the legacy Flare format.

data.minimal_example:
SplashScreen.navigate(
    name: 'intro.flr',
    next: (_) => MyHomePage(title: 'Flutter Demo Home Page'),
    until: () => Future.delayed(Duration(seconds: 5)),
    startAnimation: '1',
),
